Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE, MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Embedded Systems [ECM_3122]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Differentiate between i) General purpose systems and Embedded Systems. ii) RISC and CISC.              (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Elaborate on the mechanism of Bus technology situated in ARM processors.                               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Expand the following with syntax:                                                                      (3)  
  i)AREA ii) ENTRY iii) ALIGN  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Highlight the significance, features of Indirect addressing mode with suitable syntax or examples.     (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Categorize the Load-Store instruction by suggesting few instructions used for that.                    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           List and illustrate different data processing instructions.                                            (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                With a neat diagram, explain the working of a Barrel shifter by giving suitable examples.              (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Suggest the steps involved in case of fractional notation to evaluate any arithmetic function.         (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           With the syntax and examples, categorize the branching instructions used in ARM7.                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                Discuss the significance of 'for' loop in ARM by illustrating the example of Summing integers.         (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                         Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  Page #1

B)                Elaborate the concept of passing parameters by reference with example.                                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Write the structure for ARM APCS specification for register usage.                                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        Highlight the significance of the following: i) ISR ii) Interrupt Vector and IVT.                       (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                              Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Categorize and explain the Quality attributes used in Embedded Systems.                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)                Illustrate and explain an Application specific Embedded Systems.                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
